visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women are in an indoor room featuring a large, light-colored wooden bookshelf. The woman in the foreground, with long dark hair and a heart sticker on her cheek, wears a white diamond-patterned halter top and a white pleated mini-skirt. She starts a dance routine with energetic hand waves and rhythmic hip sways. The bookshelf behind her contains various books, framed photos, and a large purple plush toy of the Pokémon Gengar. (2) The primary woman continues her performance with arm-crossing and overhead gestures. She maintains a playful and smiling facial expression while dancing. The second woman, wearing a pale yellow crop top and a matching white skirt, is seen in the background initially looking at the shelf and then turning around to hold a smartphone as if filming or posing. The lighting is bright and uniform, suggesting a studio or well-lit home environment. (3) The dancer moves closer to the camera with more expansive movements, including hair flips and stepping towards the lens. The camera follows her with slight handheld shakes and zooms to accentuate the rhythm. Eventually, the dancer moves off-camera to the left, leaving the second woman standing still in the background, staring at the camera with a humorous, slightly stoic expression until the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic dance music begins instantly with a prominent 4/4 synthetic kick drum and bright synth stabs. Female vocals are bright and processed, singing catchy pop lyrics with high energy. The mix is studio-clean with zero background environmental noise. (2) The music maintains a consistent driving beat while the female vocals repeat the phrase 'shake it to the max'. A synthesized 'whoosh' transition effect bridge segments, adding to the high-arousal energy. Percussive elements remain the dominant acoustic texture. (3) A male vocal sample repeating 'Bad man shell out' is introduced, layered over the existing electronic beat. The track retains its high spectral brightness and dense rhythmic structure. The audio ends abruptly on a final percussive hit with a quick decay.
